title: Wraith-Hunter's Cache
description: A cache of supplies lies half-buried beneath a collapsed wall, its leather wrappings stamped with the crossed-lantern sigil of the wraith-hunters' guild. Fading ward-glyphs flicker across its surface, their protective magic nearly spent. Whoever stashed these supplies never returned to claim them.

choices.label: Break the wards
choices.description: The wards are weak enough to crack — coin and supplies wait inside.

outcomes.text: The wards shatter with a dull pop. Inside you find a wraith-hunter's field kit: coins, bandages, and a vial of purifying salve.
The wards break cleanly. A generous stash of gold and supplies — this hunter was well-funded.
The wards discharge violently as you force them. A blast of spectral energy scorches your hands before you can pull them back.

choices.label: Collect the soul ore
choices.description: Wraith-hunters always carry soul ore for ammunition and wards.

outcomes.text: You unwrap bundles of dull grey ore that pulses with trapped soul energy. Standard wraith-hunter kit — valuable stuff.
The cache holds more ore than expected. This hunter was preparing for something big.
The ore is partially corroded by the ward magic. You salvage what you can from the ruined bundles.

choices.label: Leave the cache
choices.description: Those wards were placed for a reason.

outcomes.text: You leave the cache undisturbed. The ward-glyphs flicker gratefully as you pass.
